rubric.evidence: Verified on 2026-11-27 against MDN Intl.Locale.prototype.variants (direct HTTP 200): MDN states `variants` returns 'a string of dash (-) separated identifiers' (or `undefined`), NOT `Array<string>`. Lines 23, 40, 50, and 53-55 of this stub inaccurately document `variants` as an Array<string> (`['1901']`, `['rozaj', '1994']`) and pass an array to `new Intl.Locale('sl', { variants: ['rozaj', '1994'] })` (which throws/coerces rather than accepting the string `'rozaj-1994'`).
H1 'Intl.Locale.prototype.variants' matches Chrome 149 listing; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4709921706868736; breadcrumb links /v149/.

Honest MDN redirect stub (exempt from reference-contract.json): MDN's Intl/Locale/variants page returns direct HTTP 200 with Description, Examples (locale string & options object), Specifications (ECMA-402), and Browser compatibility.
Lede and quick-reference table misstate the return type and constructor option type as `Array<string>` instead of dash-separated `string` (or `undefined`).

The <pre><code> block shows `loc.variants` returning `['1901']` and constructs `new Intl.Locale('sl', { variants: ['rozaj', '1994'] })` instead of dash-separated strings (`'1901'`, `{ variants: 'rozaj-1994' }`). Also <pre> omits tabindex='0'.
Accurately summarizes Chrome 149+, Firefox 141+, and Safari 26+ shipping alongside ECMA-402 spec and ChromeStatus links.

Live check on 2026-11-27: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/Locale/variants returns direct HTTP 200. All external links carry target='_blank' rel='noopener' and all citations (ECMA-402, tc39/ecma402 PR #960, tc39/test262 PR #4474) are directly linked.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2 headings, <header class='lede-block'>, and <footer class='byline'>. Minor legacy gaps: both .doc-table elements omit <caption>/<th scope> and <pre> omits tabindex='0'.

Uses /public/styles.css with viewport meta; recorded desktop:ok and mobile:ok in responsive-support.json (agent-reviewed 1280x800 and 360x740 screenshots on 2026-10-10 noting long title wraps cleanly on mobile).
conformance.json records demo: null and cpsFeature: null; no speculative showcase link.

followUpGoals.goal: Fix the major type/example bug on v149/intl-locale-prototype-variants/index.html: `Intl.Locale.prototype.variants` returns a dash-separated `string | undefined` (e.g. `'1901'`, `'rozaj-1994'`) and `{ variants }` takes a dash-separated string, NOT `Array<string>` (and add tabindex='0' to <pre>).

summary: Audited v149 MDN stub for Intl.Locale.prototype.variants (4709921706868736). MDN returns direct HTTP 200 with full documentation and BCD, but flagged a major factual bug: the stub documents `variants` and `{ variants }` as `Array<string>` instead of a dash-separated string (or `undefined`).
